title: VERIDIAN Auditor Engine Standard Event
description: Phase 0 (task-20260724-042659) design artifact -- PART6's 'one event schema'. Every audit-run lifecycle event across all 7 of the Owner's named repos (plus veda-advisors) emits exactly this shape into the observability/audit-trail layer: OpenTelemetry spans carry event_id as a span attribute, and pgAudit rows (for the 2 repos with a real Postgres/Supabase backend -- compliance-tracker, projexa) are cross-referenced via pgaudit_statement_id. Enforcement/emission code is a later phase; this is the contract.

domain.description: One of the 15 audit domains, or 'observability-layer-self-check', or null for repo-wide events (e.g. audit_run_started before per-domain fan-out begins).

trace.description: OpenTelemetry correlation. W3C Trace Context fields, verbatim field names so no translation layer is needed at the OTel SDK boundary.

finding_id.description: Set on finding_emitted / finding_status_changed events; foreign key into AUDITOR_ENGINE_FINDING_RECORD_SCHEMA_2026-07-24.schema.json's finding_id.

pgaudit_statement_id.description: Cross-reference into the pgAudit log's own statement id, for events where the audited action was itself a DB write (e.g. remediation_applied via a migration). Only populated for repo in {compliance-tracker, projexa} -- the 2 of the 7 named repos confirmed (drizzle/*.sql + @supabase deps) to run against a real Postgres/Supabase backend; null for the other 5, which have no DB to pgAudit (veridian-ui-kit: 0 runtime deps; claude-control: config/YAML only; the 3 reverse-engineering repos: docs/screenshots only, confirmed 2026-07-20).

metadata.description: Free-form, event_type-specific payload (e.g. audit_run_completed carries duration_ms + finding_count; escalation_raised carries owner_decision_ref).
